Name: Auto Museum Donations
Author: GSNEL
Description:
[b]Description[/b]

Donates artifacts and minerals to the Museum automatically. As soon as a donatable item enters your inventory, it gets sent to Gunther, and a chat message confirms the donation so the rest of the farm sees it.

[b]Main Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Artifacts and minerals are donated automatically as you pick them up.[/*]
[*]A chat message confirms every donation, visible to all players.[/*]
[*]Stops on its own once the Museum is fully completed.[/*]
[*]Available in 12 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, and Chinese.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/*]
[*]Works in single-player.[/*]
[*]Works in multiplayer.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher.[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or higher.[/*]
[/list]
